content: Kumuŋ gineniŋ kaikaaŋ pilakuk hatilak aditok gigit tigiŋ
Notneye, Yodoko Mede nadiiŋ hiditok mede i yolat. Hidi indiŋ mube nadiiŋ? Yodoko Mede nadiŋa mede tiloloŋ adi kaipmuŋ hatinene mu dapmalak. Kumuŋ tinene adigili dapmalak.

Unduŋ doktiŋa biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, tam yohoinit niŋdi yohoi dawi kaipmuŋ hatilune bikabudok tuwot mu tilak. Yodoko Mede foloŋ unduŋ yoŋit. Ala yohoi kumumbune adigili Yodoko Mede foloŋ yohomalam aditok mede yofafaŋe tiŋit u agaŋ dapmalak.

Tam yohoinit niŋdi yohoi dawi kaipmuŋ hatilu bikabuŋa wooŋ me gitipmuŋ niŋ dut galiwaak adi yadi yohomalam kikabi diniŋ yom hekilak niniŋdok. Yohoi kumumbune adigili, Yodoko Mededi yehifolokeneguk wendiniŋ folok u agaŋ fiyakutak. Unduŋ doktiŋa me gitipmuŋ niŋ hemimbune wendi yohomalam kikabi diniŋ yomnit mu tibaak.

Ale notneye, hidi’walaŋ mebi undugoŋ hatak. Kilisto adi kumuŋguk kaŋ hidi adut kadiŋa Yodoko Mededok kumuŋgiŋ. Ala nai indidegoŋ adi molom niŋdok gigit tigiŋ. Kumuŋ gineniŋ pilakuk hatilak aditok-ku tigiŋ oŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa indi Bepaŋdok folooŋ momooŋ tubumintamineem.
Niŋ indiŋ. Koom titiŋ kominit hatiyagumuneŋ Yodoko Mededi kadakaniŋ diniŋ nadigalika u indi foloŋ kameune kudup nabugoŋ nihidaguk, wendiniŋ folooŋ kumuliwe tubumintagumun.
Nai indidegoŋ adi Yodoko Mede wendegoŋ tiŋa kumunene Yodoko Mede’walaŋ folokŋiŋ dokodapmaguk. Unduŋ doktiŋa Munabuli diniŋ talik kobuli foloŋ hatiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ tipilapilaye-metam hatiyam.
Kadakaniŋ adi Yodoko Mede foloŋ ulodikiŋgineŋ nihitubu-kadakalak

Unduŋ doktiŋa dediŋ yodok? Yodoko Mede adi hogoli be yodok? Moŋ! Yodoko Mede mu binek hatuwek adi nu kadakaniŋ diniŋ mebi mu nadidakalelit. Yodoko Mededi indiŋ ninindakalelak. “Du metam noli’walaŋ bomboŋ fofohidok nadigalika mu tibaaŋ.” Mede u mu hatuwek adi metam noli’walaŋ bomboŋ fofohidok nadigalikafit mu tilit.
Biyagoŋ hinek, kadakaniŋ adi Yodoko Mede wondok foloŋ ulodiŋa walane nihohokeneune nemek mebimebidok nadigalikafit tugut. Yodoko Mededi daŋiniŋ mu hatuwek adi kadakaniŋdi gweheyeŋgoŋ hatuwek.
Nu koom Bepaŋ’walaŋ Yodoko Mede diniŋ mebi mu nadiŋa kedem hatigut. Ala hatigene mindaŋkade Yodoko Mede nadiwene kadakaniŋdi walane gineŋ kaikaaŋ pilalune kumuŋ tugut.
Biyagoŋ hinek kuyoŋ, Yodoko Mededi nehitubu-lodaune kulemaŋgoŋ hatidok yoŋit iŋgoŋ adi tobo nulukumuŋ tuguk.
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, kadakaniŋdi miŋ daŋiniŋ halune wendok foloŋ ulodikiŋgineŋ pilali Yodoko Mede foloŋ yotebi tiŋa naniŋkamandaaŋ nulukumuŋguk.
Unduŋ tuguk iŋgoŋ oŋ. Bepaŋ’walaŋ Yodoko Mede adi yomnit mokit, be mebiŋiŋ molomolom yehidaneeŋ yodakalegiŋ u maaŋ yomnit mokit, tiŋa adi yadi didimehi eŋ momohi.

Hidige! u deti Yodoko Mede kedemdi nulukumuŋguk? Unduŋ ba! adi kadakaniŋdi nukuk. Ale indiŋ kuyoŋ, kadakaniŋ adi ne’walaŋ mebiŋiŋ miŋgoŋ mintadakaledok tiŋa Yodoko Mede diniŋ saŋiniŋ foloŋ kisaŋ nukuk. Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, Yodoko Mededi nihitubu-lodaune kadakaniŋ diniŋ mebi hogoli hinehinek u nadidakaleyam.
Bepaŋ dut kadiŋa kadakaniŋ kedem ulatifofondok
Indi indiŋ nadiyam, Yodoko Mede adi Munabuli’walaaniŋ buguk, eŋ indi yadi kwetfoloŋ metam, kadakaniŋdi nihifolokeneune tipilapilaye tuwaŋit mokit timiyam.
Nu yadi na’walaŋ titiŋne diniŋ mebi nadiwene udaneudane tilak. Nu yadi nemek momooŋ niŋ titiŋdok nadilat iŋgoŋ u mu tilat. Eŋ nemek hogoli nisuwambat tilat iŋgoŋ uŋakoŋ tilat.
Unduŋ tiŋa nemek yosuwambat tilat uŋakoŋ tibene Yodoko Mede adi momooŋ wendiniŋ mebi mintadakalelak.
Kaŋ nemek hogoli tilat woŋ adi na nadigoŋ tiŋa mu tilat, kadakaniŋdi walane gineŋ hali naniŋgigineune tilat.

Unduŋ doktiŋa nu wendiniŋ mebi indiŋ nadilat. Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, foloone diniŋ sigine gitnem maaneŋ titiŋne komi gineŋ kedemdi yolikweli mu tiŋa hatilak. Nemek kedem titiŋdok yolat iŋgoŋ oŋ, folooŋ adi mu tilat.
Nu yadi nemek kedem tibaat yokabeleeŋ unduŋ mu tilat. Eŋ kadakaniŋ mu tibaat yokabeleeŋ mu titiŋdok yolat uŋakoŋ hinek tilat.
Wendiniŋ diki indiŋ. Kadakaniŋ mu titiŋdok yoŋila fiit tilat. Uyadi nahinek moŋ ale. Kadakaniŋdi walane gineŋ yolikweli tuguk doktiŋa adi yogigine tubune tilat.
Nu’walaŋkade yodoko indiŋ mintalak. Nemek momooŋ titiŋdok yoluwene kadakaniŋdi mintanamulak.
Nu Bepaŋ’walaŋ Yodoko Mededok nadiŋa nadigalika tilat.

Unduŋ tilat iŋgoŋ oŋ, foloone dikidiki foloŋ yodoko mede niŋ hatakdi walane gineŋ nadisu mintalak dut mindobu tiyamuk. Unduŋ tiŋa nehifolokeneune kadakaniŋ diniŋ yodoko mede foloone dikidiki foloŋ yolikweli tuguk, adi’walaŋ yot fafaŋeniŋ gineŋ itoulat.
Nu kada! Nediyeŋ foloone kumuŋdok gigit tuguk i dilitelekutnambaak?

Wapumnik Jesu Kilisto doktiŋa Bepaŋdi dilitelekutnambaak doktiŋa Bepaŋ niutumbalat. Ala indiŋ kuyoŋ. Nu na yadi walanedi Bepaŋ’walaŋ yodoko mede uŋak tipilapilaye kwanai timilat. Eŋ welene komidi kadakaniŋ diniŋ yodoko mededok tipilapilaye kwanai timilak.
